purpose: Distinguish a genuine quadratic source/Noether incompatibility from an inadmissible finite-window zero boundary by testing if the same frozen Repair14 source intersects the full canonical initial constraint manifold at z=1.5.
tests: reconstruct the exact same Repair13 backgrounds and Repair14 quadratic source used by Repair16
form the affine row-scaled 2x8 lapse+shift constraint map in canonical y at z=1.5
report coefficient rank, augmented rank, singular values and minimum-norm full-y solution
repeat on q-only columns y[0:4] with canonical momenta fixed to zero
repeat on p-only columns y[4:8] with canonical coordinates fixed to zero
reconstruct w for each candidate and verify eliminated p/density/anisotropy equations plus independent lapse and shift
do not integrate in time and do not recompute H1 or Z20

routing.FINITE_WINDOW_ZERO_BOUNDARY_INADMISSIBLE: full 2x8 canonical initial system is compatible for every material case
routing.QUADRATIC_SOURCE_INITIAL_NOETHER_INCOMPA: full 2x8 system has augmented-rank incompatibility or residual above threshold for any material case

interpretation.if_full_compatible: Repair16 only showed that y0=0 is outside the forced constraint manifold. A later preregistered propagation audit must start from a constraint-compatible state before judging source identity preservation.
interpretation.if_full_incompatible: No canonical initial state can satisfy the independent constraints for the frozen source, licensing a direct sector-by-sector quadratic Noether/source audit.

explicit_nonchanges: no Lambda c1 or c2 edit
no source sign or component-order edit
no source taper or window edit
